evidence.reason: `_expand_instance` derives `instance` directly from the raw unit filename, so `%i` is the escaped instance name. systemd's `%I` specifier is the unescaped instance name (for example, `crq\x2dtick` vs `crq-tick`). Line 177 substitutes the escaped text for both specifiers, so `Service=%I.service` resolves to an escaped target that the dependency scan does not match, dropping the reference. The smallest compatible fix is to apply systemd unit-name unescaping only to the `%I` replacement while leaving `%i` unchanged.
